text:
Alex (Growth): Heads-up — planning a ~30min micro-webinar for APAC/EU friendly time. Need run-of-show, speaker slots, and how we route inbound leads. Thoughts?
Maria - Events: Love it. Leaning 2x10m lightning demos + 8m panel Q&A. Keeps it tight for folks in Asia. Speakers: Tanya (Platform), Leo (Customer), maybe Marco for infra bits.
Jonah (Design): 2x10 is good. Can we reserve 2m intro + 2m wrap -> total 26m. I'll make a slide template with 3 slides per demo (problem, approach, live).
Priya (Eng Ops): Routing: we should attach UTM + a 1-click calendar CTA. Propose Zapier -> SFDC lead create + tag "webinar_apac_2026". Also capture the demo choice in a "demo_interest" custom field.
Alex (Growth): @Priya that SFDC mapping works. Can you add an auto-assignment rule for SDR followup within 24h? We'll want SLA in place.
Priya (Eng Ops): Yep — will create rule: if tag contains webinar_apac_2026 -> owner pool = APAC_SDRs, followup_due = now + 1d. I'll post mapping later.
Maria - Events: Rehearsals: dry-run 48h before, mic check 15m before show. Can we do a 25m tech run and one 30m full dress? Need everyone's availability.
Jonah (Design): For demo slides, share this quick template (I'll paste in the drive):

```
Slide 1: Hook + 1 metric
Slide 2: Live demo steps (3 bullets)
Slide 3: CTA + lead form screenshot
```

Alex (Growth): Nice. For lead forms — we should include one question: "Which capacity are you evaluating? (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)" so SDRs can prioritize.
Priya (Eng Ops): Good call. Also add a hidden param to the registration flow: model_workload_type. Helps routing to solutions EPD.
Maria - Events: Greenroom ops: @GreenroomBot can we schedule automated cues? e.g., "T-10: switch to speaker view", "T-2: start recording", and a post-webinar survey link in chat.
GreenroomBot: Confirmed. I will post: T-25 rehearsal reminder, T-10 switch, T-2 recording, T+1m survey. Also can pin the run-of-show doc in chat.
Alex (Growth): Decisions: 2x10 demos + 8m panel, SFDC tag = webinar_apac_2026, SDR followup 24h, registration question on capacity. Owners: Maria (schedule + greenroom), Priya (lead mapping + SLA), Jonah (slides), Alex (copy + panel moderator).
Jonah (Design): I'll deliver slide deck by EOD Wed. Can someone paste speaker bios (50 words) here so I can slot them?
Maria - Events: Posting bios now: Tanya — "Tanya leads platform product, focuses on inference performance and cost. Loves benchmarks and practical guidance." Leo — "Leo is a solutions lead at AcmeCorp, shipped inference into production at scale." Marco — "Marco runs infra at ScaleOps, background in GPU provisioning and reliability."
Alex (Growth): Final ask — who will handle live fallback if LLM demo times out? Prefer an engineer on standby. @Priya can you ensure an eng oncall for demo windows?
Priya (Eng Ops): Assigning demo oncall: Marco will be standby for infra; Tanya will have a scripted recorded clip if live fails (2m). I'll add to run-of-show.
Maria - Events: I'll put the consolidated run-of-show in Drive and pin link here. Tentative rehearsal slots: Thu 09:00 and Fri 03:00 UTC. Please RSVP.
Alex (Growth): Perfect. Thanks team — will follow up with external copy for registration tomorrow. :party-parrot:
